question: After the fall of the Mauryan Empire, which dynasty was founded by Pushyamitra Shunga, the general who killed the last Mauryan ruler?
solution: The correct answer is __**Shunga Dynasty**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Pushyamitra Shunga** was the founder of the **Shunga Dynasty**. He overthrew the Mauryan Empire by assassinating the last Mauryan ruler, **Brihadratha**, during a military parade. • The Shunga Dynasty was established in approximately **185 BCE** and lasted until **73 BCE**. • Pushyamitra Shunga was a military general under the Mauryan ruler Brihadratha and later became the ruler by staging a coup. **He declared himself king and established the Shunga Dynasty**. • The Shunga Dynasty ruled over a significant part of Northern and Central India, including the regions of Magadha, Pataliputra, and Ujjain. • While the Shungas succeeded the Mauryan Empire, their reign was marked by a revival of **Brahmanical traditions**, as opposed to the Buddhist ideals supported by the Mauryas.
